title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: International Visitor Arrivals and Cultural Event Attendance
prompt: The line graph below shows the number of international visitor arrivals (in millions) to a country and the attendance at cultural events (in thousands) in that country from 2010 to 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为雅思学术类写作 Task 1 练习。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据折线图总结主要特征并进行比较，不要表达个人观点或解释原因。建议先识别总体趋势和关键转折点，再对比两条线的变化幅度与相互关系。注意使用准确的数字和单位，并确保达到至少150词。
